display_information.name: Link Bookmarks
display_information.description: Save and organize links from Slack messages
display_information.long_description: Link Bookmarks lets you save links from any Slack message into a personal collection. Browse, search, and share your saved links without leaving Slack. Add it to any channel and type "Hi Bot" or use the slash command `/save-bookmark` to save your first bookmark

slash_commands.description: Save a link to your bookmarks
Search and display your saved links
